turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[Compress to floor]
    C --> D[Name evaporation]
    D --> E[Locate operative sentence]
    E --> F[Report ratio and erosion]
    F --> G[Flag missing rough edge]
    G --> H[This is a finding, not a draft.]

    B -->|Draft prompt| I{Mode stated or inferable?}
    I -->|No| J[Ask for mode]
    J --> I
    I -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| K[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    K --> L{Floor passes?}
    L -->|No| M[Ask up to three questions]
    M --> K
    L -->|Yes| N[Compress prompt]
    N --> O{Cut removed specification?}
    O -->|Yes| P[Revert destructive cut]
    P --> N
    O -->|No| Q{Two empty cuts?}
    Q -->|No| R{Floor still passes?}
    R -->|No| S[Return last passing version]
    R -->|Yes| N
    Q -->|Yes| T[Prompt is minimal]
    S --> U[Output PROVIDE template]
    T --> U
    U --> V{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    V -->|Keep negotiating| N
    V -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| W{Execution tools available?}
    W -->|No| X[Gate stays closed]
    W -->|Yes| Y[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    Y --> Z{Result}
    Z -->|Success| AA[Done]
    Z -->|Floor failure| AB[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    AB --> N
```
